items.title: Neocloud Lambda secures $1B in debt to buy more chips
items.summary: Neocloud Lambda has raised $1B in private debt to buy Nvidia AI chips and lease them to Microsoft. It's the latest in a string of loans, underscoring the high cost of the AI boom.

items.title: An Anthropic researcher just gave us a peek at self-improving AI
items.summary: Given 10 benchmarks for specific misaligned behaviors, the automated systems were able to improve performance on every single one without degrading overall performance.

items.title: Open-weight AI companies are the Valley’s hottest acquisition targets
items.summary: There's a lot of capital pouring into the business of giving models away.

items.title: Anthropic gets its first court win over the Pentagon’s supply-chain risk label
items.summary: A federal judge ruled the Trump administration illegally labeled Anthropic a supply-chain risk, handing the AI company a victory as its second Pentagon lawsuit continues in Washington.

items.title: Meta executive leaves for OpenAI as the social media giant faces growing scrutiny in India
items.summary: Sandhya Devanathan will oversee some OpenAI operations across Southeast Asia and Australia in her new role.

items.title: Our decision on Cursor following its acquisition by SpaceX
items.summary: Our decision to wind down our contract providing OpenAI models to Cursor following its acquisition by SpaceX.
